decisions.reason: As a system product that builds on the firm's flooring engineering and in-house R&D, it is close enough to existing know-how for incremental improvement, even if it sits somewhat outside the firm's style-led core.

A mobile arena floor is technically related but more niche and project-based than the firm's main residential and design-oriented trajectory, so management is more likely to redeploy resources unless learning effects are clearly strong.
Because it overlaps with another mobile arena system while requiring specialized selling and support, it is a likely candidate for portfolio pruning if it does not add distinctive reusable knowledge.

This flagship chevron parquet is tightly aligned with the firm's surface know-how, trend research, and stated direction toward natural, style-oriented flooring, so absorptive capacity strongly favors retention and refinement.
The squash court surface finish is niche, but it leverages the firm's coating and sports-floor knowledge and can be improved internally at relatively low development cost.

Oak skirting for sports floors is a complementary accessory with strong fit to existing wood-processing and system-selling capabilities, making it comparatively cheap and sensible to keep in the range.
